name: OpenPort Single-Host Durable Action Obligation Profile v0.4
summary: Executable public reference profile for crash-recoverable single-host action obligations, stable effect identifiers, leased worker claims, stale-claim fencing, compensation states, and digest-chained transitions.
claimBoundary: This profile is a single-host SQLite/WAL reference state machine. It requires an idempotent effect receiver for ambiguous-delivery recovery and does not establish general exactly-once execution, distributed consensus, multi-host safety, automatic compensation correctness, or private Accentrust production architecture.

checks.description: A scope-key digest MUST bind one request fingerprint, action type, effect envelope digest, and compensation envelope digest; changed reuse MUST fail closed.
Submission and its first transition MUST commit or roll back as one SQLite transaction.
Action or compensation completion at or after claim expiry MUST fail closed; expired work MAY then be reclaimed, while the previous claim token MUST remain fenced from completing the obligation.
Every obligation MUST expose stable action and compensation identifiers for receiver-side idempotency across ambiguous retries.
Compensation MUST be an explicit, separately claimed state transition and MUST NOT be inferred as successful after an unknown outcome.
Unknown or non-retryable outcomes without a safe automated recovery path MUST remain visible in manual_review.
State transitions SHOULD be linked by digests for local integrity diagnostics; this is not an externally anchored tamper-proof audit guarantee.
